text:
maya: Heads-up — starting bring-up for us-west4 GPU cluster next sprint. Need to lock GPU quota + short reservation window for smoke tests. Can someone run the procurement request and list exact numbers we should ask for?

liam: I can take the quota request. What node types + GPUs are we targeting?

maya: Goal: 24x v100-ish equivalents for initial cluster (dev/staging), plus 8x for canary production. Prefer 32GB-class cards if available. So ask for 32 GPUs (dev+canary) initially. We'll add buffer for priming: request +10% (~35 GPUs) to avoid immediate QOS issues.

evan: FYI for cost calc: 32 x a2-standard? or GCP A100? We should be explicit in the request. If we go with A100-80GB preemptible vs guaranteed — procurement should request both regular and preemptible quota. Example split: 24 guaranteed, 12 preemptible.

liam: Good point. I'll draft request with two SKUs: 24 x nvidia-a100 (guaranteed), 12 x nvidia-a100-preemptible. Tagging @gcp-sales in the body.

s-rez: Add the expected concurrent pods / per-GPU utilization numbers — helps support approve sizing. For priming tests we need sustained 70% util for 30m windows. Put that in the justification.

infra-bot: [ticket created] ENGINFRA-4821 — "us-west4 GPU quota & reservation for cluster bring-up" — assignee: liam — link: https://tracker.internal/ENGINFRA-4821

tilly: Also include network egress cap ask. If we spin up many nodes during bootstrap egress to our S3 mirror spikes. Suggest requesting temporary higher egress quota for 24 hours.

liam: Drafted the quota JSON, paste below — please sanity-check before I submit:```json
{
  "project": "redwood-prod-usw4",
  "region": "us-west4",
  "quota_requests": [
    {"metric": "NVIDIA_A100_GPUS", "amount": 36, "purpose": "cluster bring-up + buffer"},
    {"metric": "NVIDIA_A100_GPUS_PREEMPTIBLE", "amount": 12, "purpose": "cost-saving burst capacity"},
    {"metric": "NETWORK_EGRESS_GB_PER_DAY", "amount": 5000, "purpose": "bootstrap mirroring and tests (24h bump)"}
  ],
  "justification": "Bring-up of new us-west4 GPU cluster for staging + canary production. Need reserved capacity to run priming tests and initial workloads. Contact: liam@redwood.com"
}
```

maya: looks good. Add an explicit rollback window and fallback policy in the justification — e.g., we'll scale down within 2 hours if we hit quota issues.

liam: updated and submitted. Ticket updated with request ID QREQ-99823. GCP replied with estimated lead time 6–10 business days, asked for billing approval.

ops-sam: I can approve from procurement side once finance signs off. @finance please ack. Quick note on reserved capacity: if we need predictable throughput for canary, we'll want a short-term dedicated reservation (1 month) instead of just quota. That reduces risk.

evan: Agree. If finance OKs, we should add a small Dedicated reservation and a canary routing policy so production can fall back to hosted models if capacity spikes. Document in runbook.

tilly: Runbook tasks for handoff: 1) confirm quota, 2) create terraform capacity objects (PR link: https://git.internal/r/infra/terraform/pulls/184), 3) run cluster-priming playbook, 4) ops acceptance signoff. I've added checklist to ENGINFRA-4821.

liam: After ticket update, GCP rep asked for contact phone + contract owner. Shared ops-sam. Also they want expected monthly usage numbers — I used 1.2M token-equivalent compute hours estimate (rough).

maya: finance approval in progress — tracking in tracker. If green, schedule a 2-hour bootstrap window on next Tuesday (UTC morning). Whoever runs the priming please monitor GPU utilization + pod readiness.

s-rez: On validation script: run `./scripts/gpu-health-check --region us-west4 --nodes 6 --duration 30m` and capture /metrics and top output. Save to GCS under `gs://redwood-infra-priming/us-west4/<timestamp>/`

liam: will run after quota is provisioned. I'll also create short-term reservation request with cloud console and post the link.

infra-bot: [update] ENGINFRA-4821 status -> awaiting_finance_approval (added comment: "need PO or billing contact").

maya: great work — once quota confirmed, ops-sam/tilly to run handoff checklist. tagging this thread into runbook doc in Confluence. :thumbsup:

ops-sam: will own the handoff. forwarding to oncall for the bootstrap window.

liam: closing loop here — will post final QREQ response and reservation link in ENGINFRA-4821 when I have it.

maya: thanks all, keeping this pinned to the tracker for next steps."
